falsification_conditions.condition: Benchmark price (the series used for the bottom_2022_may_luna match) closes more than 12% below the swing low that anchored that match, on a daily close, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May-2022-style bottom analog is broken; price is in continuation lower, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is false and the call must resolve bearish rather than as a formed base.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2022_may_luna falls below 50% while similarity to any non-bottom template (continuation_down or distribution_top) rises above 70%, measured on the same engine pattern score.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom match was a false analog; the dominant pattern is no longer a base, so the UNKNOWN verdict tied to that match is invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or the benchmark reclaims its 50-day moving average and holds above it for 5 consecutive daily closes with volume at least 1.5x the 20-day average.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either a blowoff regime has replaced the low-37 reading, or the range has already resolved higher; HOLD/UNKNOWN is no longer tenable because the tape has left the unresolved-base state.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
